note: Era-native to consumer. Data, not code. Changing an entry is an edit and a re-export; the dataset does not move.

composite_rule.policy: map the FIRST token; record the dropped tokens in the manifest
composite_rule.why: PGM3 has one position field and 1950 has two-way players. The choice is the EXPORT's and must be visible.
composite_rule.source_artifact: StatsCrew truncates the position string at 10 characters, so codes like 'LDH-ROH-LO' and 'LDG-RDG-RO' end mid-token. A truncated trailing token is dropped by the same rule.

tokens._backs_note: 1950 single-wing and T-formation backs all collapse to RB. FB keeps the handoff's warning: rate against the real FB cohort, never as an ordinary RB.
tokens._ends_note: A 1950 offensive end blocked and caught. TE is the closer of PGM3's two; WR would import a modern split-end role that did not exist. The receiving half is lost and that loss is recorded.
tokens._mg_note: Middle guard, the nose of a five-man front. A nose tackle by alignment, an inside linebacker by responsibility, and neither. DT chosen because PGM3 rates DT on the traits a middle guard was selected for. The linebacker half is lost.
tokens._returner_note: Follows the roster project's rule: PR/KR map to WR.

refuse.policy: a token with no entry above RAISES. It does not fall through to a default.
refuse.why: Four boundary-translation bugs in the prior project all silently reduced a cohort rather than raising, because a label that does not match simply finds nothing.
